source_caption:
📺 North of North (2025–Present)

North of North follows Siaja, a young Inuk woman living in a small Arctic community in Nunavut, Canada, who decides it’s time to take control of her life after her marriage begins falling apart. Determined to create a better future for herself and her young daughter, Siaja sets out to rediscover her independence while navigating complicated family relationships, community expectations, and the challenges of starting over in a town where everyone knows everyone else’s business. As she searches for a new career, meaningful relationships, and a stronger sense of identity, Siaja finds herself in hilarious and sometimes uncomfortable situations. Starring Anna Lambe, the series combines heartfelt comedy, cultural storytelling, and emotional moments while exploring motherhood, friendship, self-discovery, and the courage to build a life on your own terms.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Stacey Aglok MacDonald & Alethea Arnaquq-Baril

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: North of North is a Canadian comedy television series that premiered on CBC Television (CBC), the Aboriginal Peoples Television Network (APTN), and Netflix in 2025, consisting of eight 24-minute episodes. It is Netflix's first Canadian original series. Anna Lambe plays Siaja, a young Inuk woman in the small fictional Canadian Arctic community of Ice Cove, on Prince of Wales Island in Nunavut. North of North, while fictional, is heavily inspired by small Inuit communities in the Canadian Arctic. On April 29, 2025, the show was renewed for a second season, which premiered in September 2026.
